type.description: Record type identifying the kind of event

created_at.description: When the record was created by the server

request_id.description: Correlation ID of the originating HTTP/etc request

tags.description: Categories/labels for filtering and grouping records

meta.description: System-managed record metadata, set automatically on creation

revision.description: Logical record revision; increments when an approved candidate replaces the record

source.description: Client that produced this record; stored as numeric ID, resolved to name in API responses

data.description: Client-supplied payload capturing the details of the event
